questions.text: Why do transformers require positional encoding, unlike RNNs?
options: Transformers process tokens in parallel with no inherent notion of sequence order
Transformers use convolutional layers that are position-invariant
Positional encoding replaces the need for an embedding layer
RNNs use positional encoding internally, but transformers must add it explicitly
questions.explanation: Transformers process all tokens simultaneously via self-attention, treating input as a set, not a sequence. Without positional encoding, 'cat sat mat' = 'mat sat cat'. RNNs encode order naturally by processing tokens sequentially.

questions.text: What is the primary advantage of multi-head attention over single-head attention?
options: It reduces the total number of parameters in the model
It allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces
It eliminates the need for residual connections
It forces each head to attend to a fixed window of neighboring tokens
questions.explanation: Multi-head attention splits representation into subspaces, letting different heads capture different relationship types (syntactic vs. semantic). It doesn't reduce parameters or constrain heads to local windows.

questions.text: Which are true about the original 'Attention Is All You Need' architecture?Select all that apply
options: It uses an encoder-decoder structure for machine translation
It relies on recurrence in the encoder to capture long-range dependencies
It uses residual connections and layer normalization to stabilize training
The decoder uses masked self-attention to prevent attending to future positions
questions.explanation: The original transformer uses encoder-decoder for translation, residual connections + layer norm, and masked self-attention in the decoder. It does NOT use recurrence — eliminating recurrence is the paper's central contribution.

questions.text: Why did transformers largely replace RNNs and LSTMs for sequence modeling?
options: Transformers use less memory than RNNs for the same sequence length
RNNs cannot model any long-range dependencies, while transformers can
Transformers allow full parallelization during training, whereas RNNs must process tokens sequentially
Transformers do not require backpropagation, unlike RNNs
questions.explanation: The key advantage is parallelization: RNNs process sequentially (slow). Transformers compute attention over all positions simultaneously. RNNs CAN model long-range dependencies in theory. Transformers actually use MORE memory (quadratic). Both use backpropagation.

questions.text: In self-attention, what do Query (Q), Key (K), and Value (V) represent conceptually?
options: Q = what a token is looking for, K = what a token offers to match, V = actual content to aggregate
Q = the token's position, K = the token's embedding, V = the attention weight
Q, K, V are three identical copies of the input with no distinct roles
Q determines output length, K determines input length, V stores positional encoding
questions.explanation: Q (Query) = what info a token seeks. K (Key) = what a token advertises. Their dot product determines attention weights. V (Value) carries the content that gets weighted and summed.

questions.text: De ce au nevoie transformer-ele de codificare pozițională, spre deosebire de RNN-uri?
options: Transformer-ele procesează token-urile în paralel, fără noțiune inerentă de ordine secvențială
Transformer-ele folosesc straturi convoluționale care sunt invariante la poziție
Codificarea pozițională înlocuiește nevoia de strat de embedding
RNN-urile folosesc codificare pozițională intern, dar transformer-ele trebuie să o adauge explicit
questions.explanation: Transformer-ele procesează toți tokenii simultan prin self-attention, tratând input-ul ca mulțime, nu secvență. Fără codificare pozițională, ordinea cuvintelor s-ar pierde.

questions.text: Care este avantajul principal al atenției multi-cap față de atenția cu un singur cap?
options: Reduce numărul total de parametri din model
Permite modelului să participe simultan la informații din subspații de reprezentare diferite
Elimină nevoia de conexiuni reziduale
Forțează fiecare cap să participe la o fereastră fixă de tokeni vecini
questions.explanation: Atenția multi-cap împarte reprezentarea în subspații, permițând diferitelor capete să surprindă diferite tipuri de relații (sintactice vs. semantice).

questions.text: Care sunt adevărate despre arhitectura originală 'Attention Is All You Need'?Selectați toate care se aplică
options: Folosește o structură encoder-decoder pentru traducere automată
Se bazează pe recurență în encoder pentru a surprinde dependențe la distanță mare
Folosește conexiuni reziduale și normalizare de strat pentru stabilizarea antrenamentului
Decoder-ul folosește self-attention mascată pentru a preveni participarea la poziții viitoare
questions.explanation: Transformer-ul original folosește encoder-decoder, conexiuni reziduale + normalizare, și self-attention mascată în decoder. NU folosește recurență — eliminarea recurenței este contribuția centrală.

questions.text: De ce au înlocuit transformer-ele în mare parte RNN-urile și LSTM-urile?
options: Transformer-ele folosesc mai puțină memorie decât RNN-urile pentru aceeași lungime de secvență
RNN-urile nu pot modela nicio dependență pe termen lung
Transformer-ele permit paralelizare completă în timpul antrenamentului, în timp ce RNN-urile procesează secvențial
Transformer-ele nu necesită retropropagare, spre deosebire de RNN-uri
questions.explanation: Avantajul cheie: paralelizarea. RNN-urile procesează secvențial (lent). Transformer-ele calculează atenția pe toate pozițiile simultan. RNN-urile POT modela dependențe pe termen lung. Transformer-ele folosesc de fapt MAI MULTĂ memorie.

questions.text: În self-attention, ce reprezintă conceptual Query (Q), Key (K) și Value (V)?
options: Q = ce caută un token, K = ce oferă un token pentru potrivire, V = conținutul real de agregat
Q = poziția tokenului, K = embedding-ul tokenului, V = ponderea atenției
Q, K, V sunt trei copii identice ale inputului fără roluri distincte
Q determină lungimea output-ului, K determină lungimea inputului, V stochează codificarea pozițională
questions.explanation: Q (Query) = ce informație caută un token. K (Key) = ce oferă un token. Produsul lor scalar determină ponderile atenției. V (Value) poartă conținutul care este ponderat și sumat.

questions.text: Γιατί οι transformers χρειάζονται κωδικοποίηση θέσης, σε αντίθεση με τα RNN;
options: Οι transformers επεξεργάζονται tokens παράλληλα χωρίς εγγενή έννοια σειράς
Οι transformers χρησιμοποιούν convolutional layers αδιάφορα θέσης
Η κωδικοποίηση θέσης αντικαθιστά την ανάγκη για embedding layer
Τα RNN χρησιμοποιούν κωδικοποίηση θέσης εσωτερικά, αλλά οι transformers πρέπει να την προσθέσουν ρητά
questions.explanation: Οι transformers επεξεργάζονται όλα τα tokens ταυτόχρονα μέσω self-attention. Χωρίς κωδικοποίηση θέσης, η σειρά λέξεων θα χανόταν.

questions.text: Ποιο είναι το κύριο πλεονέκτημα της multi-head attention έναντι single-head;
options: Μειώνει τον συνολικό αριθμό παραμέτρων
Επιτρέπει στο μοντέλο να παρακολουθεί ταυτόχρονα πληροφορίες από διαφορετικούς υποχώρους αναπαράστασης
Εξαλείφει την ανάγκη για residual connections
Αναγκάζει κάθε κεφαλή να παρακολουθεί σταθερό παράθυρο γειτονικών tokens
questions.explanation: Η multi-head attention χωρίζει την αναπαράσταση σε υποχώρους, επιτρέποντας σε διαφορετικές κεφαλές να συλλαμβάνουν διαφορετικούς τύπους σχέσεων.

questions.text: Ποια ισχύουν για την αρχική αρχιτεκτονική 'Attention Is All You Need';Επιλέξτε όλα όσα ισχύουν
options: Χρησιμοποιεί δομή encoder-decoder για μηχανική μετάφραση
Βασίζεται σε αναδρομή στον encoder για μακροπρόθεσμες εξαρτήσεις
Χρησιμοποιεί residual connections και layer normalization για σταθεροποίηση
Ο decoder χρησιμοποιεί masked self-attention για αποτροπή πρόσβασης σε μελλοντικές θέσεις
questions.explanation: Ο αρχικός transformer χρησιμοποιεί encoder-decoder, residual connections + layer norm, και masked self-attention στον decoder. ΔΕΝ χρησιμοποιεί αναδρομή.

questions.text: Γιατί οι transformers αντικατέστησαν σε μεγάλο βαθμό τα RNN και LSTM;
options: Οι transformers χρησιμοποιούν λιγότερη μνήμη για το ίδιο μήκος ακολουθίας
Τα RNN δεν μπορούν να μοντελοποιήσουν καμία μακροπρόθεσμη εξάρτηση
Οι transformers επιτρέπουν πλήρη παραλληλοποίηση, ενώ τα RNN επεξεργάζονται ακολουθιακά
Οι transformers δεν χρειάζονται backpropagation
questions.explanation: Βασικό πλεονέκτημα: παραλληλοποίηση. Τα RNN επεξεργάζονται ακολουθιακά (αργά). Οι transformers υπολογίζουν attention σε όλες τις θέσεις ταυτόχρονα.

questions.text: Στο self-attention, τι αντιπροσωπεύουν εννοιολογικά Query (Q), Key (K) και Value (V);
options: Q = τι ψάχνει ένα token, K = τι προσφέρει για αντιστοίχιση, V = πραγματικό περιεχόμενο προς συνάθροιση
Q = θέση token, K = embedding token, V = βάρος attention
Q, K, V είναι τρία πανομοιότυπα αντίγραφα εισόδου χωρίς ξεχωριστούς ρόλους
Q καθορίζει μήκος εξόδου, K μήκος εισόδου, V αποθηκεύει κωδικοποίηση θέσης
questions.explanation: Q = τι πληροφορία ψάχνει ένα token. K = τι προσφέρει. Το εσωτερικό γινόμενό τους καθορίζει τα βάρη attention. V φέρει το περιεχόμενο που ζυγίζεται.
